           java-version: "25"
 
+      - name: Configure Java toolchain discovery

+        run: echo "ORG_GRADLE_PROJECT_org.gradle.java.installations.paths=${{ steps.helidon-java.outputs.path }},$JAVA_HOME" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
